production_contract: Batched Rust finished_meeting_export/replay, raw parser, exact per-window answer mapping and quoted-passage decoder
calibration_role: Diagnostic, calibration-split-only evidence. Runtime emits raw closed-set choices; raw production outputs independently must satisfy every source/item/precision gate. No fitted threshold is claimed executed.
identity_evidence: provider_reported_version; exact returned dated model, actual provider, requested upstream and official endpoint are pinned. No independently verified remote artifact or serving revision is claimed.

acceptance.hosted_warm_complete_job_p95: within the frozen configured whole-job deadline, never over 90 seconds

items: Independently authored exact SOURCE0 passage labels, commitment state, literal quote and complete production source-byte/fingerprint bindings. Unsupported owner, due and prior-event link extraction remain null. Raw candidates cannot be hidden by calibration.
calibration: Only calibration distributions fit artifacts. Exact authored physical batch templates, slot, actual batch size, original question, ordered labels, provider-model identity and grouping bind each context. Freeze fitted artifact before any held-out request.
resource_scope: Owned application-client preparation, HTTP transport and final Rust raw replay. Per-original-job whole_job_elapsed_ms is mandatory. Fixed five fresh-client and thirty warm complete jobs on a frozen development source, plus separately reported maximum512-turn development stress. Remote server CPU/RSS/weight contents are unavailable and are not claimed measured. RSS is the maximum individual-process lifetime high-water mark across the isolated client and waited children; individual client/child marks are retained. Aggregate process-tree and native GUI RSS are unmeasured and are not claimed by this manual-route gate.
adoption: Emit a candidate only after every exact-context raw/calibrated diagnostic/source/quality/resource gate passes. This runner never writes the registry. Synthetic qualification is not natural-ASR, human or automatic/background acceptance.
